message.content: lib/command.js is getting long. Move the two module-level helper functions at the bottom of it, `incrementNodeInspectorPort` and `useColor`, into a new module `lib/utils.js` that exports both, and import them from there wherever they are used, including the tests. Do not change their behavior. `node --test` and `npm run check:type:js` must pass.

input.command: grep -rn "incrementNodeInspectorPort\|useColor" --include=*.js --include=*.ts --include=*.json --include=*.mjs --include=*.cjs . --exclude-dir=node_modules | head -30; ls lib; tail -40 lib/command.js

grep -rnE "incrementNodeInspectorPort|useColor" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git | grep -v "^./CHANGELOG"; grep -n "^import\|^export\|^function\|^}" lib/command.js | tail -20; grep -n "incrementNodeInspectorPort" -B8 lib/command.js | tail -30; head -12 lib/command.js
sed -n 2700,2722p lib/command.js; grep -n "files\|lib/" package.json; grep -n "process" lib/command.js | sed -n 1,3p

content.text: Move with a script, keeping the code verbatim.

input.command:
python3 - <<'E'
p='lib/command.js'
L=open(p).read().split('\n')
# line 2711 (1-indexed) is start of jsdoc; remove from blank line before it (2710) to end
body='\n'.join(L[2710:]).rstrip('\n')+'\n'
rest='\n'.join(L[:2709])+'\n'
body=body.replace('function incrementNodeInspectorPort','export function incrementNodeInspectorPort')
body=body.replace(" * Exported for using from tests, not otherwise used outside this file.\n *\n *"," *")
open('lib/utils.js','w').write("import process from 'node:process';\n\n"+body)
rest=rest.replace("import { suggestSimilar } from './suggestSimilar.js';\n","import { suggestSimilar } from './suggestSimilar.js';\nimport { incrementNodeInspectorPort, useColor } from './utils.js';\n")
open(p,'w').write(rest)
E
sed -i '' "s#'../lib/command.js'#'../lib/utils.js'#" tests/useColor.test.js
head -20 lib/utils.js; tail -5 lib/command.js; grep -n "useColor" -B6 lib/utils.js | head -12
node --test 2>&1 | tail -8; npm run check:type:js 2>&1 | tail -5; npx eslint lib tests 2>&1 | tail -5; npx prettier --check lib tests 2>&1 | tail -3

content.text:
I moved `incrementNodeInspectorPort` and `useColor` out of `lib/command.js` into a new `lib/utils.js` that exports both. The function bodies are unchanged.

- **`lib/command.js`:** it now imports both from `./utils.js`. Its only changes are the new import line and the removed functions.
- **`tests/useColor.test.js`:** it imports `useColor` from `../lib/utils.js`.
- **`incrementNodeInspectorPort`:** it was private to `command.js`, so I added `export` to it. Its JSDoc is the same.
- **`useColor`:** I dropped its "Exported for using from tests, not otherwise used outside this file" comment, because it's now in a shared module. I kept `@package`.

`node --test` passes (1372 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped) and `npm run check:type:js` passes. ESLint and Prettier are clean on `lib` and `tests`.
